name: Kaori
source: A calm and kind girl who was crying on the first day [url=/c78567]Takuya[/url] arrived, she immediately fell under his spell. She is one of [url=/c67272]Mio[/url]'s protégés, she likes her a lot. She is often the target of [url=/c78579]Hikari[/url]'s jokes and she also seems to be his closest friend.
